page_title: Better Resource Monitor | macOS Resource Monitor for the Menu Bar

summary.name: Better Resource Monitor
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, sandboxed macOS menu bar monitor that shows CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage at a glance.
use_cases: Keep an eye on CPU, memory, and disk space while working
Spot unusual load without opening Activity Monitor
Replace a paid menu bar monitor with a free one
Monitor a battery-powered Mac with low overhead
Check network speed from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: Shows CPU, memory, storage, GPU, and network usage in the Mac menu bar so the numbers stay visible during daily work. When "Show warning colors" is enabled, the tray turns orange if CPU, memory, or GPU usage reaches 81% or available storage drops below 10 GB; this is visual only and can be turned off. It is built to be lightweight, and the page says it makes zero network requests and sends no telemetry. It is intentionally limited to core everyday metrics and does not cover fan, temperature, or battery sensors.
notable: Open source under MIT license, built with Tauri v2 and Rust
Sandboxed; no admin password or root helper needed
Works offline with zero network requests and no telemetry
Available on Mac App Store (auto-updates) or as .dmg from GitHub Releases (manual updates)
caveats: Fan, temperature, battery, and deep sensor history are not included; the page points to Stats or iStat Menus for those
GitHub .dmg builds have no automatic updates
Warning threshold is fixed at 81% / 10 GB and cannot be changed
